source: Supabase SELECT only (read-only, the Supabase MCP). Each file is (private.ballers_input_side(club, round) - 'voice')::text byte for byte: the side object private.ballers_freeze_match froze at the lock, without the club's commentary lines (`voice`: member-written text the engine never reads; compact()'s replay header carries it, the engine result does not). md5 = the server's md5((private.ballers_input_side(...) - 'voice')::text), checked after writing. ballers_match_inputs was never queried; no member handle or manager field is in a side.
round_read: round 7 (2b0e6c0a-3a4f-4723-8846-9265bf3c6e20, status done): the sides already played, never a round still to be played
plans: no club's round-7 side carries a move (plans [] for all 12 Global clubs): the parity harness attaches the ready-made moves of ../2026-10-16-release-3/move-plans.json where a block needs plans; the clubs' own saved ideas are not exported

FCD.jsonb.txt.notes: Direct preset, Mixed striker; 2 substitution orders (half, losing)

FDD.jsonb.txt.notes: free kicks Into the box; 2 tired orders

MEN.jsonb.txt.notes: Line Deep, Width Wide, Bodies forward 4; keeper Sweeper; 1 tired order

TRS.jsonb.txt.notes: Line Deep; keeper Stays on line, free kicks Short; 2 tired orders

NEO.jsonb.txt.notes: AI Counter: Deep, Selective, counter on winning it; no onLoss key

RAP.jsonb.txt.notes: AI Short combinations (old shape): striker link (Drops deep), Keep it; no onLoss key

UMA.jsonb.txt.notes: AI Short combinations (old shape): Width Narrow, striker link, Keep it; no onLoss key

INT.jsonb.txt.notes: AI Direct, Aggressive press; identical to ../2026-10-09-scenarios/sides/INT.jsonb.txt (same md5)
